diagnosis_basis.C1_observable: the v1 / A6 thrust is the thrust of the time-averaged state; on oscillating runs it is 0.48-1.00 of the time-mean of the instantaneous thrust and resolution-dependent; the vendor regression test uses the per-frame mean
diagnosis_basis.C2_window: the v1 window holds 1-30 oscillation periods; same-numerics doubled-duration runs differ by up to 14 %; over 1 x-4 x the v1 duration the batch-means SE of oscillating runs is 0.24-1.9 %, of the low-frequency run RP1|BZ-P5B30|BP-HI|VD-265|MF-HI|sgb-01 4.3-5.9 %
diagnosis_basis.C3_spatial_order: quiet cases converge monotonically at observed order 0.63-0.69: L0 -> L1 1.3-2.6 %, L1 -> L2 0.8-1.75 %; the time step is converged (CFL 0.4 vs 0.799 within statistics)
diagnosis_basis.C4_collapse: high-B_peak / low-flow points collapse to an extinct discharge and then fail numerically; escape hatch not involved

numerical_method.bridge: hallthruster_bridge/a7_numerics.jl (sha256 above) a7_record: the bridge_lib.run_case Config on the XE / vacuum / measured-B path (bit-identical to run_case at v1 numerics: checks/a7_numerics_check.jl) with SimParams and Config numerics read from the case; HallThruster.jl is never patched

driver.note: committed with the A7 tooling after this lock, byte-identical; every launch manifest pins it

solver_settings.note: the pinned v0.23.1 defaults (SimParams / Config), written explicitly into every case; the step is CFL-limited by the cell size

levels.A7-P (production): cells = 2 x cells_v1 (0.25 mm), dt_s = 2.5e-9 (escape-hatch step, scaled with the cells as A6)
levels.both: duration_s = 4 x duration_v1; average_start_s = 1 x duration_v1 (transient = the v1 duration; window = 3 x duration_v1); num_save = 4000 evenly spaced frames

observables.thrust_N: time-mean over the frames with t >= average_start_s of HallThruster.jl thrust(sol, i) (instantaneous exit ion momentum flux minus the anode term, no divergence correction)
observables.discharge_current_A: time-mean of the per-frame discharge current over the same frames; discharge_power_W = discharge_current_A x V_d
observables.ion_current_A: time-mean of the per-frame ion current (reported; read by the closure P-CPL path)
observables.standard_errors: batch means: the window frames in 10 contiguous equal batches, SE = sd(batch means) / sqrt(10), for thrust and I_d; half-window means (first / second half of the window frames)
observables.Id_rms_rel: RMS / mean of I_d over the window; quiet class Id_rms_rel < 0.5 (v1 / A3)
observables.sustained: v1 rule over the window: min I_d > 0.01 x mean I_d
observables.reported_only: thrust_avgstate_N (the v1 / A6 statistic over the same window), integrated-autocorrelation times, dominant frequency, failure-frame diagnostics

run_status_rule.precedence: NUMERICAL_FAILURE > EXTINCT > NOT_SUSTAINED > NON_STATIONARY > STATISTICALLY_UNRESOLVED > PASS (abep_hall::envelope_a7::a7_status)
run_status_rule.NUMERICAL_FAILURE: retcode != success, converged false, finite false, or a missing / non-finite thrust_N, thrust_se_N, thrust half means, discharge_current_A, its SE or half means, discharge_power_W, Id_rms_rel; an absent record is NUMERICAL_FAILURE
run_status_rule.EXTINCT: discharge_current_A < 1e-3 x e mdot / m_Xe (m_Xe = 131.293 u): a collapsed discharge (the v1 rule counted these as PASS with thrust ~1e-14 N)
run_status_rule.NOT_SUSTAINED: sustained false (v1 rule over the A7 window)
run_status_rule.NON_STATIONARY: for thrust or I_d: |half-mean 1 - half-mean 2| > 0.02 |mean| + 2 x 2 SE (2 sigma; the difference of two half-window means has SE ~ 2 SE)
run_status_rule.classes: PASS and NOT_SUSTAINED are evaluated physics; NUMERICAL_FAILURE, EXTINCT, NON_STATIONARY and STATISTICALLY_UNRESOLVED are unknowns: never feasible, never an evaluated non-closure. In the envelope an unknown carries the v1 status NUMERICAL_FAILURE with its A7 status recorded
run_status_rule.se_cap_basis: Phase 1: over the A7 window the thrust batch-means SE of resolvable oscillating runs is 0.24-1.9 % and fluctuates 2-5 x between runs of the same case (the 10-batch SE itself has ~24 % relative sampling error); the unresolved low-frequency case sits at 4.3-5.9 %. A cap of 1 % would flip resolvable cases between the two levels by sampling noise; 2.5 % lies in the observed gap. The cap bounds the statistical part of the convergence allowance at 2 x sqrt(2) x 2.5 % = 7.1 %; the allowance actually used is the per-case combined SE

convergence_criterion.basis: A3 / A6: thrust and I_d within 2 %, identical status and quiet class; ladder L1 (production) against L2 (check), the finer reference of A6

per_case.C-STATUS: the status class (PASS, NOT_SUSTAINED, UNKNOWN) at A7-P equals that at A7-C
per_case.C-QUIET: when both are evaluated physics: quiet class (Id_rms_rel < 0.5) identical
per_case.C-T: when both PASS: |T_P - T_C| <= 0.02 |T_C| + 2 sqrt(SE_T,P^2 + SE_T,C^2)
per_case.C-ID: when both PASS: |I_P - I_C| <= 0.02 |I_C| + 2 sqrt(SE_I,P^2 + SE_I,C^2)

convergence_criterion.statistical_basis: the observables of oscillating discharges are time-means of a stochastic / quasi-periodic signal; a level-to-level difference is only meaningful against their combined sampling uncertainty (Phase 1 C2). The 2 % term is kept unchanged for the discretization error; the 2-sigma term is the minimum coverage for a two-sample comparison and is zero for quiet runs (SE ~ 0), so quiet cases face exactly the A3 / A6 2 % rule
convergence_criterion.case_outcome: CONVERGED_EVALUATED: classes agree, evaluated physics, every applicable criterion passes; PERSISTENT_UNKNOWN: unknown at both levels; NOT_CONVERGED: anything else (abep_hall::envelope_a7::A7Comparison::outcome)
convergence_criterion.reported_only: observed order and the L0 / L1 / L2 diagnostic values are never part of the rule

selection_rules.a6_study_keys: the 22 A6 study cases in A6 order (14 seeded + 8 mandatory A3 failures, incl. the 209 % case, the three status flips and every case failing at all A6 levels)
selection_rules.fresh_seeded_keys: one per hardware configuration (geometry x B shape, v1 order); B_peak, V_d, mdot, transport = axis[pick(SEED|XE|geometry|shape|axis[|r<j>], n)] with SEED = NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE/A7/v1 and pick = first 8 bytes of sha256 as big-endian u64 mod n; re-picked with |r1, |r2, ... while the key is in the A3 check set or the A6 study set
selection_rules.rp1_seeded_keys: the DBF-1 hardware (G-RP1, BZ-P5B16; A9.37 / A9.38): one per B_peak x mdot level (v1 order); V_d, transport = axis[pick(SEED|RP1|XE|G-RP1|BZ-P5B16|B_peak|mdot|axis[|r<j>], n)], re-picked while in the A3, A6 or fresh sets
selection_rules.recomputed_by: abep-h1-envelope-a7 keys (crates/abep-julia-bridge/src/envelope_a7.rs demo_keys); every case-file generation refuses unless it reproduces these lists

rp1_subset.rule: every demonstration key with geometry G-RP1 (both B shapes)

demonstration_subset.runs: 42 cases x (A7-P, A7-C) = 84 runs in two case files: the RP-1 subset (22 runs, run first) and the rest (62 runs); each frozen before scoring

pass_rule.rule: over a scope: no NOT_CONVERGED case and at least one CONVERGED_EVALUATED case -> A7_CONVERGED_SUBSET_DEMONSTRATED; otherwise A7_STOP_NOT_DEMONSTRATED

scopes.RP1: the RP-1 subset, scored once from its frozen case file as soon as it completes -> a7_demonstration_rp1_result_v1.json; gates Stage 1
scopes.ALL: every demonstration case, scored once from both frozen case files -> a7_demonstration_result_v1.json; gates Stage 2

pass_rule.persistent_unknowns: cases unknown at both levels do not fail the pass rule; they are listed and counted in the result and stay unknowns in any envelope. They are never dropped. A case unknown at one level and evaluated at the other is NOT_CONVERGED (fails the rule)
pass_rule.no_margin_tier: there is no numerical-margin tier: a NOT_CONVERGED case stops the scope
pass_rule.stop: A7_STOP_NOT_DEMONSTRATED for a scope: no grid stage it gates is generated or run; HALL_NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED stays, with the diagnosis and the scored result as the finding

envelope_rerun_plan.stage_1: after the RP-1 scope is demonstrated: every G-RP1 case of the registered v1 XE grid (both B shapes, both B_peak levels, all V_d and mdot, all nine transports: 324 cases) at A7-P; case file cases/h1_parametric_envelope_a7_xe_grid_stage1_v1.json (header pins the RP-1 result sha256); launch manifest launch_manifest_a7_xe_grid_stage1_v1.json; frozen and ingested on its own as soon as it finishes (A9.37); an interim report follows
envelope_rerun_plan.stage_2: after the ALL scope is demonstrated: the other 1944 XE cases at A7-P, the same way (stage 2 case file and launch manifest; header pins the full result)
envelope_rerun_plan.unchanged: only numerical fields change; nothing dropped, nothing rerun at other numerics, no case chosen by outcome
envelope_rerun_plan.ingestion: abep_hall::envelope_a7::ingest_a7: own raw-manifest schema (np_hall_parametric_envelope_a7_raw_manifest_v1), every record checked (A7 case sha256, HallThruster commit, A7 lock, v1 lock, stage case-file sha256, family XE, v1 key and case sha of the stage), each supplied stage complete or MODEL_ERROR, the gating demonstration result re-read and required demonstrated; points carry the v1 identity and the A7 status
envelope_rerun_plan.harness: abep-assess harness v2 with --envelope-xe-a7-stage1 [--envelope-xe-a7-stage2]: the XE_CONTINGENCY Hall constraints are the A6 tests HALL_XE_T12_AT_PBUS and HALL_XE_T25_CAPABILITY_AT_PBUS (unchanged definitions, HC-01 / HC-02 / HC-03 from the frozen configuration) over the supplied stages, on one hardware configuration; EC-NUM cites A7 (sampled demonstration, not per point); with Stage 1 only the scope is the G-RP1 hardware and the record says so; C0..C4 unchanged; the v1 and A6 XE envelopes are reported only
envelope_rerun_plan.dry_run: a labelled harness v2 dry run on each ingested stage (not the M2 run; the coordinator starts M2)
envelope_rerun_plan.air: AIR is not rerun: the AIR family is information only under A1 (no admitted Hall O / O2 chemistry), and its rerun would cost about as much as the XE grid (not small)
envelope_rerun_plan.labels: every A7 point: PARAMETRIC / NOT_VALIDATED, SOURCED_SURROGATE B(z), TRANSPORT_EXTRAPOLATED (credible set EMPTY), NUMERICS_A7_DEMONSTRATED (sampled)

execution: Rust-generated case files (byte-reproducible, abep-h1-envelope-a7 check), the A7 driver (pin, locks, inputs, case file, A7 bridge checked), Rust launch with sidecars; threads / BLAS 1; Julia 1.11.7; each record carries the commit, versions, host and hashes; outputs frozen (abep-h1-envelope-a7 freeze) before any scoring or ingestion; each scope scored once (abep-h1-envelope-a7 score-demo) and committed whatever the outcome
change_control: any change to the method, status rule, criterion, subset, pass rule or rerun plan after this lock is a new, dated addendum registered before the runs it governs
